systems.name: EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra
systems.cycle_life: 3,500 cycles to 80%+ capacity (10+ years daily cycling)
systems.outdoor_rating: IP54 (Protected against dust and splashing water)
systems.transfer_switch_ecosystem: EcoFlow Smart Home Panel 2 (12 Breaker Circuits + App Control)
systems.target_users: Homeowners demanding plug-and-play 240V backup for central AC and well pumps without complex utility permitting
pros: True 120V/240V split-phase native output from a single unit with zero external transformers
7,200W continuous output effortlessly runs central air conditioning and heavy well pumps
Dual MPPT solar controller supports up to 5,600W including high-voltage 450V rooftop arrays
0ms instantaneous online UPS switchover protects sensitive computers, servers, and medical equipment
Modular stackable design on heavy-duty casters requires no mandatory wall anchor inspection
cons: Base unit is heavy (Inverter 70 lbs + Battery 116 lbs = 186 lbs combined stack)
Reaching maximum 90 kWh whole-house off-grid capacity requires purchasing additional inverters

systems.name: Tesla Powerwall 3
systems.noise_level: <40 dB (Liquid-cooled inverter fan under full solar production)
systems.transfer_switch_ecosystem: Tesla Backup Gateway 2 / Tesla Backup Switch
systems.target_users: Homeowners doing full rooftop solar installations wanting seamless whole-house backup and unified Tesla app control
pros: Tremendous 11.5 kW continuous output backs up entire large households including Level 2 EV charging
Integrated 6-MPPT solar inverter simplifies installation by eliminating third-party string inverters
Sleek architectural wall-mount enclosure rated IP67 for extreme outdoor weather resistance
Massive 185A LRA starting capability powers high-tonnage heat pumps without soft-starters
Storm Watch automatically tops off battery from the grid prior to severe storm warnings
cons: Requires certified electrician and extensive utility interconnection permitting
Not portable; permanent wall installation with professional conduit runs

systems.name: Bluetti EP900 + B500 Home Battery
systems.transfer_switch_ecosystem: Bluetti Smart Home Panel / Grid-Tie Interconnection
systems.target_users: Homeowners wanting an outdoor IP65-rated wall/floor mount with grid-sellback capability and high continuous wattage
pros: IP65 outdoor rating allows space-saving outdoor mounting on exterior home walls
9,000W continuous output easily runs multiple 240V circuits simultaneously
Can sell excess solar generation back to the electrical utility for net-metering credits
Outstanding 5,000+ cycle lifespan backed by an industry-leading 10-year warranty
High-voltage solar input (up to 550V) reduces wire gauge requirements and line loss
cons: Requires at least two B500 batteries (9.9 kWh) to unlock the full 9,000W output rating
Requires professional installation for full 240V main-panel sub-feed

systems.name: EcoFlow DELTA Pro
systems.max_capacity_kwh: 25 kWh (Expandable with Extra Batteries + Smart Generator)
systems.voltage_output: 120V Native (240V achievable via Double Voltage Hub linking 2 units)
systems.transfer_switch_ecosystem: EcoFlow Smart Home Panel (Gen 1) or 30A Transfer Switch
systems.target_users: Budget-conscious buyers, RV owners, emergency apartment backup, and mobile job sites
pros: Highly accessible sub-$2,500 entry price point for a massive 3.6 kWh LFP power station
Built-in luggage pull handle and rugged rear wheels for genuine portability
Can recharge at public Level 2 EV charging stations (3,400W) in under 1.8 hours
Integrated 30A RV receptacle for direct travel-trailer off-grid hookups
Seamless integration with EcoFlow Dual-Fuel Smart Generator for infinite runtime
cons: Single unit produces 120V only; running 240V well pumps or central AC requires 2 units + hub
1,600W max solar input is smaller than whole-home competitors

systems.name: Anker SOLIX X1 Home Energy Storage
systems.target_users: Aesthetic-focused homeowners seeking an ultra-thin 15cm wall-mount system with independent battery optimization
pros: Ultra-slim 5.9-inch (15cm) depth sits flush against garage or outdoor exterior walls
Independent energy optimizers per battery module ensure bad packs never throttle total capacity
Natural convection fanless thermal architecture operates in total near-silence
Built-in thermal pre-heating enables reliable performance down to -20°C (-4°F)
6,000 cycle lifespan supported by a 10-year comprehensive warranty
cons: Modular 5 kWh slices can get expensive when scaling past 20 kWh
Relatively new platform compared to Tesla and EcoFlow established ecosystems
